tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Che cosa chiede la signora?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. Report what someone said with che (dice che …) or an indirect question with se (yes or no) or a question word: dove, quando, perché, a che ora (non so dove abita). Put the blue verb in the right form. After che, se and the question words the sentence keeps its normal word order, and you do not write a question mark. A tile in brackets such as (lui) says who is meant; you don't write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Chiede se la farmacia è aperta.
“Se” per una domanda sì o no. “Che” per quello che si dice.
